image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting in a natural environment with dry twigs and soil. The rabbit has dense greyish-brown fur, large upright ears with dark tips, and a visible white fluffy tail. Its hind legs are tucked beneath its body, and forelegs are partially obscured by the angle and ground cover.
